text.jpText:
クラスの連中がスイーツの話で
盛り上がっててさ。
text.enText:
The girls in my class were talking about 
this place that serves desserts and stuff.

text.jpText:
今度みんなで食べに行こうって、
その場のノリで決まったらしいんだよね。
text.enText:
They suddenly decided to go all together, 
which got everyone excited.

text.jpText:
で、全員の予定を聞いて回りだしたからさ。
……抜けてきたってわけ。
text.enText:
They were going around and asking everyone 
what their schedules were like… So I left.

text.jpText:
甘いの苦手なヤツとかいたら……
変な感じに盛り下がるでしょ、多分。
text.enText:
I don't really like sweets, so… I'd probably 
just ruin the mood, you know?

text.jpText:
……あーっ。なんでうちのクラスはこう、
妙に懐っこい連中が多いんだろ。
text.enText: Ugh… Why does everyone in my class have to be so friendly?
